blocks.text: South Surrey Presale Condos: streets and boundaries

items.t: A South Surrey presale can sit in two municipalities: the City of Surrey, or the City of White Rock, and the approvals pipeline differs by city.

White Rock's Development Application Information Portal covers the whole city from City Hall at 15322 Buena Vista Avenue, and holds Official Community Plan (OCP) amendments, Zoning Bylaw amendments and development permits.

blocks.text: South Surrey Presale Condos: the housing stock

items.t: The presale form in the Surrey reports read is low-rise: at 17046 20 Avenue the proposal is two mixed-use buildings with 94 residential units and 71 townhouse units, a 5-storey and a 6-storey building.
That site needs an OCP text amendment because the Commercial designation allows a floor area ratio (FAR) of 1.50 and the applicant proposes 2.45 on the north lot.

blocks.text: South Surrey Presale Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Presales in British Columbia are regulated under the Real Estate Development Marketing Act (REDMA), and the BC Financial Services Authority (BCFSA) is the regulator; seek advice from a lawyer, notary or licensee before signing, per BCFSA's own guide.
A developer must give a buyer a disclosure statement, with a reasonable opportunity to read it before signing, and material facts about the development go in that statement, not the brochure.
Effective April 1, 2025, disclosure statements filed under REDMA Policy Statement 14 carry a completed "Summary of Pre-Sale Risks and Buyer Rights" form at the front.

BCFSA runs a pilot that lets projects of 100 or more units extend the early marketing period from 12 to 18 months; whether a South Surrey project is in the pilot is stated in its disclosure statement.

blocks.text: South Surrey Presale Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: White Rock keeps major projects with approved zoning on a separate Construction Information Portal, so a project can be approved yet absent from the applications list a buyer checks first.
White Rock's current zoning bylaw is Zoning Bylaw 2024, No. 2506, adopted June 27, 2024, the bylaw a disclosure statement's zoning description should match.
The Darts Hill site at 17046 20 Avenue also needs an NCP amendment deleting a land consolidation requirement, a step that can precede rezoning by months.

blocks.text: South Surrey Presale Condos: development and new projects

items.t: Mixed-use project, 17046 20 Avenue, Surrey (Darts Hill): two buildings, 94 residential units and 71 townhouse units, rezoning from RA to CD plus an OCP text amendment and an NCP amendment. STATUS: planning report dated May 12, 2025, read 2026-11-03.

blocks.text: South Surrey Presale Condos: costs and taxes

items.t: Surrey's 2026 all-in Class 1 residential tax total on the City schedule is 3.42731 per $1,000 of assessed value; a presale buyer is taxed on assessed value after completion, not on the contract figure.
Both Surrey and White Rock are designated taxable areas for the provincial Speculation and Vacancy Tax, so the annual declaration applies to a completed presale unit in either city.

blocks.text: South Surrey Presale Condos: getting around

items.t: South Surrey Park and Ride, at King George Boulevard and Highway 99, is served by routes 321, 351, 352, 354 and 394, the transit base most Grandview and Sunnyside presale sites rely on.

blocks.text: South Surrey Presale Condos: risks and due diligence

items.t: The main presale risk BCFSA names is completion risk: a buyer who cannot complete faces the contract's remedies, so read the completion, deposit and default sections of the disclosure statement before the rescission period expires.

Check servicing before assuming a Grandview presale completes on the marketing timeline: the neighbouring application at 17008 20 Avenue proceeds independently while sharing road and riparian dedications with the 17046 site.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in South Surrey Presale?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in South Surrey Presale?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in South Surrey Presale?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
